_comment: TEMPLATE - Copy this file and customize for your own training plan
_instructions: 1. Replace all placeholder values with your actual data. 2. Delete sections starting with underscore (_). 3. Validate with: python validate_config.py --config your_config.json

current_fitness._run_base_distance_help: Longest comfortable run distance in miles
current_fitness._bike_base_distance_help: Longest comfortable bike ride in miles
current_fitness._weight_note: Set target_weight_lbs = weight_lbs if no body comp goal
current_fitness._pace_help: Format: MM:SS per mile at easy conversational effort

training_plan._total_weeks_help: How many weeks from start to end (typically 12-24)
training_plan.goal_summary: Describe your primary and secondary goals here

races._comment: Add one object per race. Remove if no races (training only)
races._week_help: Which training week this race occurs in
races.name: Race Name Here
races._elevation_optional: Can omit elevation_feet if flat course
races.notes: Any special considerations: altitude, terrain, weather, etc.

nutrition_plan._comment: Customize phases based on your goals. Common patterns: weight_loss (aggressive deficit early), race_only (maintenance calories), muscle_gain (surplus)

phases.name: Foundation Phase
phases._duration_help: Specify EITHER duration_weeks OR duration_days, not both
phases._deficit_help: Calories below TDEE. Use 0 for maintenance, negative for surplus

food_lists._comment: Define your own food lists or use templates. ultra_constrained = most restrictive, expanded = most variety

am_workouts._comment: Optional morning workout routine. Can omit entire section if not applicable

workout_templates._comment: Optional custom workout definitions. System has defaults if omitted
